viewport-fit=cover so env(safe-area-inset-*) is non-zero on a real notched device.
         Harmless on desktop; inside the DS device frame the insets are simulated instead.

Brand fonts (CX-67112): Inter for all text, titles included, JetBrains Mono for code. Nunito Sans
         stays loaded above for the screens that still name it directly.

IBM Plex Sans/Mono back the `--f-*` tokens under theme="ibm-light|ibm-dark". Without this the
         IBM type tokens silently fall back to a system sans and the whole reskin looks half-applied.

Restore the theme attribute BEFORE bootstrap. Angular sets it from FeatureFlagService in an
         effect, which runs after first paint — so without this the app flashes light-on-reload in dark
         mode, and Coralogix-on-reload in IBM mode. Mirrors apps/web-app/src/index.html upstream.
         Reads the same two keys the app owns: `cx-theme` (ThemeService) and `cx-proto-flags-v2`
         (FeatureFlagService, overrides only — an absent ibmMode means the default, false).

Mobile design system. A separate compilation unit loaded AFTER styles.scss so it lands
         past @tailwind preflight — see the header of src/cx-ui-mobile/index.scss.
